svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 PostgreSQL writes: JPA entities, JDBC batches, partitions and PL/pgSQL

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 PostgreSQL writes: JPA entities, JDBC batches, partitions and PL/pgSQL
Path A: Device entity and credentials
flush is not commit. A later credentials failure still rolls back the outer transaction.
Entity UUID hash selects one local writer.
The LinkedBlockingQueue has no configured capacity.
attribute last_update_ts is stored but is not used as an update predicate.
An older write submitted later can overwrite a newer value.
Path C: SQL telemetry partition and batch
[already exists, overlap or default contains rows]
Path D: Alarm PL/pgSQL state transition
FOR UPDATE serializes an existing row.
First concurrent creation has no row to lock and the active index is not unique.
Kafka and database are separate commits
There is no XA or outbox transaction.
A crash after DB commit and before offset commit causes replay.
Cluster capacity is the sum of all service pools and other clients.
VACUUM progress, long snapshots and WAL/checkpoint pressure affect write latency.
